description_en: Adds a memory entry to a DataAgent
description_zh: AddDataAgentMemory 添加 DataAgent 记忆
kebab_example: aliyun dms add-data-agent-memory --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --session-uuid fc5ice0000000000ac6e --content Diamond_pricing_analysis_requires_examining_the_skewness_and_outliers_of_the_distribution_of_each_feature. --label fact_specifications --mem-from user --from-id 2037000000000023 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataAgentMemory

parameters.help_en:
The session ID.
Note: This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh:
会话ID
注意：该参数已废弃
parameters.name: session_uuid

parameters.example: Diamond pricing analysis requires examining the skewness and outliers of the distribution of each feature.
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en:
The memory label. Valid values:
fact_specifications: fact definitions.
task_constraints: node constraints.
execution_config: execution configuration
parameters.help_zh:
记忆标签
fact_specifications - 事实定义
task_constraints - 任务约束
execution_config - 执行配置
parameters.name: label

parameters.help_en:
The memory source. Valid values:
session: generated from a session.
user: edited by a user
parameters.help_zh:
记忆来源
会话生成：session
用户编辑：user
parameters.name: mem_from

parameters.help_en:
The source ID.
If MemFrom is set to session, FromId indicates the session ID.
If MemFrom is set to user, FromId indicates the RAM user ID
parameters.help_zh:
来源ID
当MemFrom为session时：FromId表示会话ID
当MemFrom为user时，FromId为用户子账号ID
parameters.name: from_id
